items: Each child's profile now shows their own yard, with their house and their monster and pets walking around.
📬 Mailbox: grown-ups can send a note (and record their voice). It's read out loud when the child opens it.
🌱 Garden: plant a seed, and every Dojo earned waters it until it blooms.
⚽ Throw a ball, 🍎 give a snack, and 🛁 bath time when the monster gets muddy.
Lots more free looks in Make: eye styles, eyebrows, noses, cheeks, arms and hands, tummies, new tops, mouths and colours.
⚡ Quick start: a one-minute tap-through guide for grown-ups, on the home screen.
Secret pictures: each child can have 3 secret pictures they tap to open their own profile in Kids' play, so brothers and sisters can't spend each other's Dojo $. Set them in Settings, under Children.
When an update is ready, the banner now has a "What's new" button so you can see the changes before you update.
A brighter, lighter look with soft pastel colours, the same on every phone.
Settings is now on the home screen (with the parent PIN), split into short pages: Children, Rewards, Games, Family and This device.
Inviting someone is easier: the invite is a ready-made message with simple steps, and the link joins them to the family automatically.
New people get a welcome screen showing how to add the app to their home screen.
This "What's new" screen pops up after each update. Open it again any time from Settings, under This device.
